mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a temperature of 70 degrees with slight rain currently falling at the Verona Community Park under a Waning Gibbous moon.

The City of Verona is currently managing the Verona Cemetery on North Main Street, where residents and non-residents alike can purchase plots. Also, remember that road surface treatments are scheduled across the city from August 4 to August 7.

Today, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the Remote Area Medical Clinic will be at Verona Area High School, and the Sugar River Paddle and Jamboree will celebrate our local watershed.
During the period of July 20 to July 27, the Verona Police Department handled a variety of calls including E-moto enforcement and several O W I investigations.

Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Raspberry Cheesecake. Additionally, you can find Kona Ice at Fireman's Park today from 12:30 PM to 4:30 PM. The store is open until 10:30 PM tonight, so stop by and grab a treat.
